resources.string: Unable to open TubeBeam. Check that it is installed and enabled, then try again.

TubeBeam sends YouTube links to SmartTube on an Android TV. Install and configure TubeBeam on your phone, install SmartTube on the TV, and enable network ADB debugging on a trusted home network. This is separate from Chromecast and FCast.
WizeStream keeps local playback running because TubeBeam cannot confirm that the TV started playing. Pause locally after the TV starts.
Queue on TV is not offered because stock SmartTube does not support it.
